title: A Trail for the Horizon
author: Paloma Vasquez
blurb: Yara Brightwater, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
